selection.pool: first 100 repository metadata results from one page, preserve raw response
selection.ranking: stars descending then full_name ASCII case-insensitive ascending
selection.admission: Walk ranked unexposed repositories; admit first six pinned default-branch trees with 1..12 regular tracked src/main/**/*.kt files (total <=196608 bytes), excluding previously exposed repository identities and original blob SHAs; retain full source-file inventory in Git path order
selection.dependencyPolicy: No dependency injection based on source inspection; compilation limitations are recorded as abstentions and reserved candidates are never retroactively substituted

evaluation.oraclePolicy: Independent original-source contracts authored and cryptographically precommitted before Hunter; no oracle or gold answer available to Hunter sandbox
sequence: freeze engine commit and excluded source identities
select metadata-only original cohort and commit reservation
run frozen Hunter isolated without oracle access
adjudicate exact witnesses and preserve negative results
evaluation.noveltyRule: A finding counts only when a second distinct original Kotlin defect is first predicted blind and later independently verified; hypotheses, uncovered disagreements and synthetic fixtures do not count
